title: On Liouiville Type Theorem for the 3D Isentropic Navier-Stokes System without D-condition
summary: In this paper, we establish Liouville-type theorems for the steady compressible Navier-Stokes system. Assuming a smooth solution \(u \in L^p(\mathbb{R}^3)\), \(3 \le p \le \frac{9}{2}\), with bounded density, one obtains \(u \equiv0\). This generalizes the result of Li-Yu \cite{Li-Yu} by removing the Dirichlet condition \(\int_{\mathbb{R}^3} |\nabla u|^2 \, dx < \infty\). If \(\frac{9}{2} < p < 6\), Liouville-type theorem holds under the additional oscillation condition for momentum \(ρu \in \dot{B}^{\frac{3}{p} - \frac{3}{2}}_{\infty,\infty}(\mathbb{R}^3)\).
